description:
Follow-up to task-d27edf88 (claim_next_task now answers accountSwitch for a flagged idle seat; the mod marks it). Two subtree guides went stale:
- scripts/CLAUDE.md, Claude account rotation bullet: "It adds `acceptsAccountSwitch` to `submit_plan`/`chat_wait`" (held by task-3416b309 when d27edf88 was planned; now DONE).
- packages/moe-daemon/CLAUDE.md, Claude account rotation bullet: "a seat holding no task (`idleSwitchFor`): `submit_plan.accountSwitch`, or an early `chat_wait` return. ... Both idle signals need acceptsAccountSwitch".
Also accountStore.ts idleSwitchFor's doc comment ("an architect after submit_plan, a governor in chat_wait"). Name claim_next_task in each; docs/MCP_SERVER.md is already synced.

implementationPlan.description:
Name claim_next_task as the third idle account-switch signal in the DoD's three places. These are text and comment edits only: no code, no test and no build.
- First confirm the behavior these words describe is still the one landed for task-d27edf88. Look at MARKED in scripts/mods/moe-account-switch/hooks/register.ts, the acceptsAccountSwitch check in packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/claimNextTask.ts, and the **Account switch** paragraph of docs/MCP_SERVER.md `### moe.claim_next_task`. If its final landing changed the reply, word the edits to match and say so in the completion summary.
- Make every change with your Edit tool, never sed, a heredoc or cp (global rail: a shell write leaves no TOOL witness). Each OLD below occurs exactly once (checked 11-04 on e575ecec+5265909c). Copy it exactly: ASCII quotes, LF.

(a) scripts/CLAUDE.md:42, the **Claude account rotation** bullet. It is one 8.5k-char line, and it stays one line. Replace only this sentence:
OLD: It adds `acceptsAccountSwitch` to `submit_plan`/`chat_wait`, so the daemon can move the seat between tasks.
NEW: It adds `acceptsAccountSwitch` to `submit_plan`/`chat_wait`/`claim_next_task`, so the daemon can move the seat between tasks: `claim_next_task` covers a row that ended without `submit_plan` (`archive_task`), whose next in-session claim answers `hasNext:false` with `accountSwitch` and claims nothing.
Leave the later 'the mod refuses `claim_next_task`/`wait_for_task`/`chat_wait`/`start_step`' as is. That is the HELD set, and it is still true.

(b) packages/moe-daemon/CLAUDE.md, the **Claude account rotation** bullet.
Line 14 OLD: `submit_plan.accountSwitch`, or an early `chat_wait` return.
Line 14 NEW: `submit_plan.accountSwitch`, a `claim_next_task` `hasNext:false` with `accountSwitch` in place of a claim (after the governor redirect, `alreadyAssigned` and the caller's own `ATTEMPT_FINALIZING` refusal, before any ranking or write; no `nextAction`), or an early `chat_wait` return.
Line 16 OLD: Both idle signals need
Line 16 NEW: All three idle signals need

(c) packages/moe-daemon/src/state/accountStore.ts. JSDoc text only: keep the ` * ` prefixes and the /** */ delimiters, and change no code line.
idleSwitchFor's comment (DoD 1). OLD (2 lines):
 * The switch for a seat between tasks: an architect after submit_plan, a
 * governor in chat_wait. A seat holding a task waits for its step boundary.
NEW (3 lines):
 * The switch for a seat between tasks: an architect after submit_plan or at
 * its next claim_next_task (a row it ended without one, e.g. archive_task), a
 * governor in chat_wait. A seat holding a task waits for its step boundary.
ACCEPTS_ACCOUNT_SWITCH's comment, about 10 lines up, makes the same stale claim, so fix it too. OLD (4 lines):
 * The input the moe-account-switch mod adds to submit_plan and chat_wait. Only
 * a session that ends itself and is relaunched by its wrapper's loop can act
 * on a switch between tasks; every other seat keeps its account until its
 * next launch, as before.
NEW (4 lines):
 * The input the moe-account-switch mod adds to submit_plan, chat_wait and
 * claim_next_task. Only a session that ends itself and is relaunched by its
 * wrapper's loop can act on a switch between tasks; every other seat keeps its
 * account until its next launch, as before.
implementationPlan.note: Behavior verified against register.ts MARKED and claimNextTask.ts; wording matches.

implementationPlan.description:
docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md, section `### An architect or governor session ends and restarts on its own` (about lines 997-1016). It lists only submit_plan and chat_wait as the switch points, in two bullets. This is beyond the DoD's three places, but it is the same stale claim. The file is not vendored (mem:gotcha-moe-doc-generated-artifacts: the generators read only docs/roles, docs/agents and docs/skills), so nothing needs regenerating. Use Edit. The new lines keep the file's ~120-column hard wrap (widths 120/56 and 118/24), and each step-3 grep phrase stays on one line.

(a) The 'It happens:' list. OLD (1 line):
- for an architect, right after a `submit_plan`;
NEW (2 lines):
- for an architect, right after a `submit_plan`, or at its next in-session `claim_next_task` (for example after a row it
  ended with `archive_task`), which then claims nothing;

(b) The **Cause:** list. OLD (2 lines):
- the daemon put `accountSwitch` in a `submit_plan` or `chat_wait` reply, for the same reasons as a worker's switch
  above;
NEW (2 lines):
- the daemon put `accountSwitch` in a `submit_plan`, `claim_next_task` or `chat_wait` reply, for the same reasons as a
  worker's switch above;

Leave the rest of the section as is:
- 'The architect's plan is recorded first' still holds for submit_plan.
- 'A call the model makes after the switch (a claim, another `chat_wait`) is refused' is the mod's HELD set.

Out of scope:
- The architect role docs (docs/roles/architect.md:34 and architect.reference.md **Claude account switch**). They are vendored into initFiles.ts, and task-7e9ba059 owns them.
- docs/plans/2026-10-20-claude-account-rotation.md, a dated design record.
- docs/MCP_SERVER.md, which d27edf88 already synced.

Verify once, then self-review once. This step changes no file.

1. From the worktree root, run this exact command and submit its fresh output as the complete_task verification. It is also the plan's checkRef:
grep -c 'acceptsAccountSwitch` to `submit_plan`/`chat_wait`/`claim_next_task`' scripts/CLAUDE.md && grep -n 'idleSwitchFor`): `submit_plan.accountSwitch`, a `claim_next_task`' packages/moe-daemon/CLAUDE.md && grep -n 'All three idle signals need' packages/moe-daemon/CLAUDE.md && grep -n -B5 '^export function idleSwitchFor' packages/moe-daemon/src/state/accountStore.ts | grep claim_next_task && grep -n 'mod adds to submit_plan, chat_wait and' packages/moe-daemon/src/state/accountStore.ts && grep -n '`submit_plan`, `claim_next_task` or `chat_wait` reply' docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md && grep -n 'next in-session `claim_next_task`' docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md && ! grep -n 'Both idle signals' packages/moe-daemon/CLAUDE.md && bash scripts/tests/parity-check.sh && npm run lint

- Every grep phrase fails on the unedited text (checked on e575ecec+5265909c) and passes on the step 1-2 text (dry-run on scratch copies).

2. Self-review `git diff` and `git status --short`:
- In accountStore.ts every changed line starts with ` * `, no `*/` was added, and the delimiters are untouched. That is why no tsc run is needed. Do NOT run tsc in the worktree: a tsc emit run left the stray register.js/register.test.js that got task-d27edf88 reopened.

- The wording matches what register.ts MARKED and claimNextTask.ts do as landed.

Covers DoD 1 and DoD 2.
